summary: Master the art of investment portfolio management with our expert-led course. Take control of your financial future and make informed investment decisions.
lede: Investment portfolio management helps finance professionals manage assets in line with client or institutional objectives and risk tolerance. The course addresses portfolio construction through strategic asset allocation and security valuation, alongside risk analysis using VaR and stress testing. It also covers ESG integration and performance attribution to assess portfolio decisions and communicate results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for financial professionals who are responsible for managing, analyzing, or overseeing investment assets within institutional or private wealth contexts.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial markets and basic proficiency in Excel. Prior experience in financial analysis or accounting is recommended but not required.
